# pcd_blockstorage_quotaset (Resource)

Manages the Cinder (block storage) quotas for a project. Only the quota fields you set are managed; fields you omit keep their server value. Destroying this resource stops managing the quotas but does not reset them to their defaults.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_identity_project" "demo" {
  name = "demo"
}

resource "pcd_blockstorage_quotaset" "example" {
  project_id = data.pcd_identity_project.demo.id
  volumes    = 50
  snapshots  = 50
  gigabytes  = 1000
  backups    = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The project (tenant) the quotas apply to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `backup_gigabytes` (Number) Quota for total backup storage in gigabytes.
- `backups` (Number) Quota for the number of backups.
- `gigabytes` (Number) Quota for total volume storage in gigabytes.
- `groups` (Number) Quota for the number of volume groups.
- `per_volume_gigabytes` (Number) Quota for the size of a single volume in gigabytes.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `snapshots` (Number) Quota for the number of snapshots.
- `volumes` (Number) Quota for the number of volumes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite `<project_id>/<region>` ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_blockstorage_quotaset.example <project_id>/<region>
```
